core_obligations: Statement (lines 3205-3214): for U an m-truncated simplicial object and n <= m, the colimit of U(n) over ([n]/Delta)_{<= m}^{opp} exists and equals U_n.

Verification (proof lines 3205-3214): the index category ([n]/Delta)_{<= m} has an initial object, namely id: [n] -> [n], since n <= m; a colimit over a category with an initial object evaluates at that object, which here is U_n.
proof_roadmap: Identify the initial object of the truncated coslice category.
Recall that colimits over categories with an initial object evaluate there.
difficulty_reason: Trivial skeleton colimit (statement 3205-3214, proof 3216-3219): complete one-observation argument, dual to the coskeleton case. H3.
